explanation: Prepares hosted delivery of the pinned HypoMap atlas without turning either flag on. The data-host path rule and the burst rule now admit only hypomap/<tag>/ manifest.json, metadata.json.gz, search-index.json.gz and length-pinned genes-NNNN.json.gz shards (scripts/lib/hypomapAtlas.mts); upload:bundles publishes the verified atlas on full uploads or with --hypomap-only, storing .json.gz as application/gzip with no Content-Encoding; off-origin builds drop dist/hypomap; verify:edge gains --hypomap probes. delivery.md documents the CORS requirement, the Content-Encoding effect on checksums, the unverified cached-CORS risk and the manual publication order.
